description: Public NASA and NOAA datasets fetched for Earth Information Jukebox Phase 2

sources.name: NASA Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER)
sources.license: NASA Open Data Policy (public domain / free worldwide access)

variables.T2M: Temperature at 2 Meters (deg C, annual mean)
variables.T2M_MAX: Maximum Temperature at 2 Meters (deg C, annual maximum)
variables.PRECTOTCORR: Precipitation Corrected (mm/day monthly mean; converted to annual total mm)
variables.ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN: All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance (kW-hr/m^2/day, annual mean)
variables.WS2M: Wind Speed at 2 Meters (m/s, annual mean)
variables.RH2M: Relative Humidity at 2 Meters (%, annual mean)

sources.name: NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies (GISS) Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP v4)
sources.variable: GLB.Ts+dSST Land-Ocean Global Temperature Anomaly (deg C relative to 1951-1980 baseline, J-D mean)

sources.name: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory (GML) Mauna Loa Atmospheric CO2
sources.license: U.S. Government Work / Freely available public domain data
sources.variable: Annual mean atmospheric carbon dioxide mole fraction (ppm)

sources.name: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) WMS
sources.license: NASA Earth Science Data Systems (ESDS) Open Access Policy
sources.resolution: 512x512 JPEG, ~2x2 degree bounding box centered at region lat/lon
sources.cloud_filter: Seasonal candidate dates evaluated via white-pixel fraction; lowest cloud fraction chosen

optional_layers_checked.VIIRS_Black_Marble: Tested; dynamic tile requests require specific projection bounds
optional_layers_checked.MODIS_Terra_NDVI_8Day: Tested; valid NDVI composite layer available on GIBS
